scenes.say: Every IVF index in FAISS starts as twenty-five full passes of k-means. What if two or three were enough?

scenes.headline: How e-means beats k-means in a tenth of the epochs
scenes.sub: Mini-batches, a moving average, and two fitted laws
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Wrenly! This is e-means, from Meta FAIR, now in FAISS. Watch the two algorithms move, and you'll see why.

scenes.credit: the authors' toy, from the lead author's post

steps.say: This is Lloyd's algorithm, on the authors' toy. Assign every point to its nearest centroid, then move each centroid all the way to the mean of its points.

steps.caption: One move per full pass over the data
steps.say: One move per full pass, and the loss only goes down. So a bad start never gets fixed. It gets polished.

scenes.text: Keep a moving average of each cluster's count and sum, take many small steps per pass, and let fitted laws pick the batch and step.
scenes.say: e-means changes one thing. It keeps a moving average of each cluster's count and sum, and takes many small steps per pass.

scenes.title: The update, rewritten as a step

parts.note: toward this batch's mean of the cluster
parts.say: Each update moves a centroid toward its cluster's mean in this batch.

parts.note: batch count over the faded count
parts.say: How far depends on the step, and on this batch's count over the faded count.

parts.note: batch = all data, step 1: one Lloyd iteration
parts.say: Make the batch the whole dataset, with a step of one, and you get Lloyd back. Lloyd is one corner of this family.

scenes.say: Here is the whole update, as one step.

scenes.credit: the authors' toy, from the lead author's post

steps.say: Same points, same bad start. Each mini-batch moves a centroid a fraction of the way toward its batch mean.

steps.caption: The noise is doing work
steps.say: A batch is a sample, so the centroids jitter. That noise pulls the crowded pair apart.

params.left: Lloyd: one exact move per pass

steps.say: Side by side, in this film's own simulation. Five blobs, and one bad start.
Lloyd converges fast, and stays stuck.
e-means takes small noisy steps, and a centroid finds the empty blob.

steps.term: Mini-batch: a small random sample of the points
steps.say: Many small steps found what one exact step could not.
The article has a playground that runs both for real. Sixteen hundred points, twenty-four centroids, the same random start.

steps.caption: Left: Lloyd. Right: e-means.
steps.say: Press play. Lloyd, on the left, moves once per pass. e-means, on the right, is done after three.
Six hundred small updates against Lloyd's twenty-five, and the blue curve ends just under the red one.
It is not a clean sweep. Step to other seeds, and sometimes the ratio under the chart turns red. Lloyd wins that one.

states.say: At three epochs, e-means ends below Lloyd on twenty-eight of them.
At one epoch, only ten. The laws are being stretched here, far below the sizes they were fitted on.

steps.say: Flip revival off, and it wins twenty-five seeds instead of twenty-eight. On this toy that is a small effect.

steps.caption: Table 14: 4,313 dead clusters without it, 47 with the split
steps.say: At real scale it is not. On a million points, four thousand three hundred and thirteen clusters die without it, and forty-seven with the split.

scenes.title: No sweep: two laws pick the recipe

steps.say: And nobody tunes it. Take a million points and three epochs.
A fitted law picks the batch: sixty-five thousand five hundred and thirty-six.
A second picks the peak step, zero point three six one.
That is forty-eight updates, where Lloyd makes three.
About four points per cluster each time. Sixteen noisy moves per pass, against one exact one.
The paper's curves. One is Lloyd at twenty-five iterations. Blue, e-means, drops below it within a few epochs.

steps.caption: 1.4 to 2.6 epochs to beat Lloyd at 25
steps.say: The orange mini-batch baselines stall above the line. Across the datasets, e-means needs one point four to two point six epochs.

items.text: Quality gain: fractions of a percent
items.say: Two cautions. The loss gain is fractions of a percent. The story is compute.

items.text: The laws were fitted on embeddings
items.say: And the laws were fitted on high-dimensional embeddings, not on tiny data.

scenes.text: Lloyd was the costliest corner of a bigger family. Many small, scheduled, noisy steps get there in a tenth of the passes.
